title: Canonical single-module direct-image comparison map
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], choose the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and let $M$ be any $\mathcal O_X$-module. For the derived direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image], define $\alpha_{f,M}:(f_*M)[0]\to Rf_*(M[0])$ by first applying the localized canonical single-complex identification $(f_*M)[0]\cong Q(f_*(M[0]))$, then the right-derived unit $Q(f_*(M[0]))\to Rf_*(M[0])$. This is the explicit map canonicalSingleDirectImageMap, defined for every $M$, without an acyclicity, flatness or invertibility assumption. Here $Q$ denotes localization from the homotopy category of module complexes to the derived category.

source.place: Tag 079V, section-unbounded: the right-derived unit for termwise module direct image; specialized to the single complex. Used for the structural unit in Tag 0GKA.

def canonicalSingleDirectImageMap {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules) :
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj ((pushforward f).obj M) ⟶
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M)
